cv.name: Laura Kessler-Moretti
cv.headline: Executive Assistant to C-Level | Former Hotel Front Office Manager
cv.summary: Executive assistant with six years supporting senior leaders in life sciences, after an earlier career in luxury hotel operations. Brings calm under pressure, guest-level service and fluent German, English and Italian.

experience.title: Executive Assistant to the Chief Medical Officer
bullets: Manage the CMO's calendar, travel and board meeting preparation across three time zones
Organise quarterly leadership offsites for up to 40 people, including budget and vendors
Prepare presentations, minutes and follow-up actions for the Medical Leadership Team
Introduced a shared action tracker in MS Teams/Planner used by the whole leadership team

experience.title: Team Assistant, Clinical Operations
bullets: Supported a team of 18; coordinated expense reports in SAP Concur and contract filing
Onboarded new joiners and kept the department intranet up to date

experience.title: Front Office Manager
bullets: Led a front office team of 12 in a 5-star hotel with 180 rooms
Handled VIP guest arrangements and complaint resolution

education.degree: Diploma in Executive Assistance (Direktionsassistentin mit eidg. FA)
